description:
Delete MapTag (types/sigs.rs:20) and its 23 tag-reading sites in the type kernel. A struct type is a record whose __struct__ field is the module's atom (%Pt{x: int} = %{__struct__: :"Elixir.Pt", x: int}); proven by a scratch kernel test, 14/14 identities, scratchpad proof/scratch_struct_field_encoding.patch. map_top is every map; the six callers meaning every map (resolve.rs:118, dispatch_reachability.rs:323, type_pred.rs:94, semantic.rs:617, :2444, types/mod.rs:521) widen with no change; the protocol target Map (world.rs:3138, module_impl_target_ty) becomes map_top \ %{__struct__: atom}, so protocols stay struct-first. The runtime predicate's struct axes (runtime_type_predicate.rs, types/mod.rs:3580) read __struct__ in either layout. StructTag's ModuleId dependency moves to struct_module_value_ty. Fixtures: is_map(p), case p do %{x: x}, MapSet unchanged, Enumerable miss on a struct, a Map.put-grown struct dispatching as its struct. Every moved pin reported with mechanism; none edited without authorization. Docs: set-theoretic-types.md, any-value.md, protocols.md, guides. Waits for S1 and for fz-sc8.99 to land (dispatch_matrix files).

Two gaps this ticket closes, both present on 6566a5765 and unchanged by S1: (1) Map.get(p, :__struct__) on a struct panics in run and build with "cannot coerce atom and numeric raw ABI reprs" (native_codegen/fn_ctx.rs:495); Map.get's specialization reads __struct__ through field_lookup as a numeric field slot. Interp prints Pt. The same field_lookup path is a risk for any typed read of __struct__ at a field offset. (2) Map.get/3, Map.has_key?/2 and Map.merge/2 on a struct raise BadMapError on every path, because a 'map ::' clause guard does not admit a struct. Elixir answers :none, true and a merged map. Both become fixtures here once the struct type is a map type.
title: A struct is a map type: MapTag goes
